text: Choosing this clinic for my first filling was a huge mistake. About a week after the filling, I started experiencing sensitivity and pain when chewing. The dentist asked me to come back for a check-up and an X-ray. The X-ray sheet was a hard piece; the nurse asked me to bite down the first time, but I couldn't, my palate abraded and bled. The second time, I couldn't bite down again, and it bled even more. I asked if I could skip the X-ray, but it took about 3-4 attempts before I finally got it right. The dentist said it was probably because my palate has a large bone structure. After the X-ray, the dentist said everything was fine and to wait a week, without giving me any advice on how to care for the bleeding palate. Almost a month has passed, and my palate is still scarred from the X-ray scraping. Eating is painful because food scrapes against the wound, making eating unbearable. My mouth is no longer the same; the filling is still sensitive and painful when I chew. It was a huge mistake.
